title.en: Liquid AI releases open d1 edge decision models
title.zhHans: Liquid AI 发布开放式 d1 边缘决策模型

searchSummary.en: Liquid AI released d1-3B and experimental d1-omni-600M as downloadable decision models for text, vision, and audio-oriented edge workflows.
searchSummary.zhHans: Liquid AI 发布可下载的 d1-3B 与实验性 d1-omni-600M，面向文本、视觉及音频边缘决策工作流。

summary.en: Liquid AI released d1-3B and experimental d1-omni-600M as downloadable decision models for text, vision, and audio-oriented edge workflows.
summary.zhHans: Liquid AI 发布可下载的 d1-3B 与实验性 d1-omni-600M，面向文本、视觉及音频边缘决策工作流。

narrative.en: The release makes compact decision checkpoints available for local evaluation. Liquid’s latency and quality comparisons remain vendor-run, multimodal benchmarks are incomplete, and the model cards use Liquid’s own license rather than a standard permissive license.
narrative.zhHans: 该发布使紧凑型决策检查点可供本地评估。Liquid 的延迟与质量比较仍由厂商执行，多模态评测尚不完整，模型卡采用 Liquid 自有许可证而非标准宽松许可证。

text.en: Liquid AI released d1-3B and d1-omni-600M as downloadable decision models on October 7, 2026.
text.zhHans: Liquid AI 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日发布可下载的 d1-3B 与 d1-omni-600M 决策模型。

text.en: The multimodal evidence is incomplete, reported performance is not independently replicated, and the weights use Liquid’s LFM license.
text.zhHans: 多模态证据尚不完整，性能未得到独立复现，权重采用 Liquid 的 LFM 许可证。
